verdict.rationale: Bland documents batch calls that launch high-volume outbound campaigns from an uploaded CSV of recipients, and positions itself for dispatching outbound calls to leads and customers at high volume. The evidence does not show the scheduling or throughput controls the story asks for; triggers are event-driven calls, not campaign scheduling. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling (start times, calling windows), throughput or concurrency/rate controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch campaigns.
